description: This is a test source file for the litellm project, containing unit tests for the OpikLogger integration, including both asynchronous and synchronous functions, as well as various edge cases and regression tests related to tracing and span attachment.

methods.name: test_opik_logging_http_request()
methods.description: Tests that HTTP requests are batched correctly for the OpikLogger in asynchronous context, ensuring batching behavior without immediate HTTP calls.

methods.name: test_sync_opik_logging_http_request()
methods.description: Tests the synchronous HTTP request behavior of OpikLogger, verifying that multiple calls batch correctly and are sent after a delay.

methods.name: test_opik_logging()
methods.description: Verifies the overall logging and batching behavior, both for standard and streaming completions, in an asynchronous test.

methods.name: test_opik_attach_to_existing_trace()
methods.description: Regression test for attaching spans to an existing trace, ensuring no new trace is created but span attaches to existing trace_id.

methods.name: test_opik_create_new_trace()
methods.description: Tests creation of new trace and span when no trace_id is provided, verifying proper referencing and tagging.
